title: Caesar's Memo
summary: A warehouse memo was scrambled before it was left on a desk. Read it, then read what it hides.
objectives: Work out how the memo was scrambled
Decode the release code inside it
learningOutcomes: Break a shift cipher by frequency or brute force
Explain why secrecy of the method is not security

references.label: CWE-327: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm

hints.bodyMd: Spaces and line breaks survived. Only the letters changed, and each one seems to have moved the same distance.
There are only 25 possible shifts. Once the memo reads as English, look at the character set of the release code.
